answer: To register, an attacker must post collateral per identity, making mass fake participants economically ruinous, like hauling marble across a frozen tundra. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to stake a scarce, verifiable resource before earning: a bonded deposit locked against a shared ledger. Reputation accrues only through peer-attested work, so a fresh identity starts at zero on the mesa of trust and must climb slowly.
